scope: Two full datasets, CPU/FP64 CUDA, 20 training seeds per dataset/backend (10 without sampling,10 with row+feature sampling), five fresh stratified splits, eight stress profiles, all guarded cases 500 rounds. Additional CPU tiny-leaf checks cover four other seeds per dataset. Not a guarantee for arbitrary datasets or parameter settings.
publication_note: Compact observations omit full trajectories, model files and prediction arrays. Original record SHA256 values refer to unmodified retained records; record_id is a portable identifier within that retained bundle, not a downloadable relative link. Machine paths and timings are omitted; this is not a speed benchmark. Per-case library_sha256 and native_provenance are authoritative.

validation.definition_of_stability: Completes all 500 requested boosting rounds, finite loss at every round and predictions at checkpoints, bounded constant-leaf linked steps, raw-score magnitude below 100, and held-out quality gates. Loss need not improve monotonically.

upstream_empty_child_comparison.result: All four runs fail at iteration 28 with actual empty-child assertion, despite manual max_delta_step=10 (training learning_rate=0.1).

default_compatibility.purpose: CPU compatibility comparison of baseline runtime-cpu and exact-partition runtime-empty-child for default fraud and covtype training, plus deterministic 50-round layout-pinned covtype probes.

environment.dataset_splits: Cached fraud/covtype train and test arrays under retained-artifact/cache

fraud.interpretation: The one threshold sign difference changes no partition on the cached train/test rows; this is observed-data equivalence only and does not imply globally identical behavior on unseen exact-zero rows.

first_topology_difference.partition_relationship: Features 10 and 12 are exact complements on the ancestor rows, so these candidate splits partition the rows identically with left/right swapped.

covtype.interpretation: The default run diverges substantially in later model structure and raw scores, although the first differing local split is an equivalent-feature near tie and final held-out quality is close. The experiments do not isolate causality between the implementation change and nondeterministic histogram/tie ordering.

deterministic_50_round_covtype.interpretation: Pinned deterministic layout probes do not reproduce the 500-round default divergence. This is evidence that default auto-layout/nondeterministic tie behavior is relevant, but is not proof of the specific cause.

metric_scope_note: Binary and softmax observations contain stable_raw_logloss. The two covtype OVA stress observations contain probability_logloss from normalized independent-sigmoid outputs and no stable_raw_logloss; their prior comparison uses the retained probability metric.
